** Additional attack multipliers: 1st hit 140% / 2nd hit 180% / 3rd hit 220%

* Consumes all Discbombs from all enemies when used

* Flare Passion: Physical resistance +5% and Type resistance +5% and -10MP costs per each stack (max stack: x3, +15%, -30MP)
